store.shortDescription: Rugby fixtures, kick-off times, and pub watchability — all national teams and tournaments, in your local timezone. Free, no login. WatchRugby.
store.fullDescription:
WatchRugby is a free app that brings together every rugby national team and tournament — national teams (men's, women's, U20, sevens), the provinces (Leinster, Munster, Ulster, Connacht), clubs and domestic cups, the Six Nations, Rugby World Cup, URC, European Champions Cup, European Challenge Cup, and more — and every world national team and global tournament.

Every fixture is shown in your local timezone, so you can tell at a glance whether a match is watchable from a pub near you wherever you are. National teams are featured first; world teams (Southern Hemisphere, Pacific, Europe) follow. Pub watchability is assessed relative to your local clock — a 6pm kick-off in your timezone is pub-friendly wherever you are.

Coverage:
• Men's Senior National Team — Six Nations, Autumn Internationals, Summer Tour, Rugby World Cup (featured)
• Women's Senior National Team — Women's Six Nations, Women's Rugby World Cup (featured)
• U20 Men's and Women's National Teams — U20 Six Nations, U20 World Cup (featured)
• Sevens National Team — Sevens World Series, Sevens World Cup (featured)
• Leinster, Munster, Ulster, Connacht — URC, Champions Cup, Challenge Cup, domestic cups
• Clubs and domestic cups — Leinster Senior Cup, Munster Senior Cup, Ulster Senior Cup, Connacht Senior Cup
• Six Nations, Women's Six Nations
• Rugby World Cup (2027 in Australia), Women's Rugby World Cup
• United Rugby Championship (URC)
• European Champions Cup, European Challenge Cup (EPCR)
• Sevens World Series, Sevens World Cup
• Rugby Championship (New Zealand, South Africa, Australia, Argentina)
• Pacific Nations Cup (Fiji, Samoa, Tonga, Japan)
• Rugby Europe Championship (Georgia, Romania, Spain, Portugal)
• World national teams — men's and women's, all unions
• World timezones reference — convert any kick-off to your local time

Privacy: no personal data is collected to serve ads. Before non-essential adverts load, you can choose to accept or reject them — your choice is saved on your device. The group planning grid saves only to your own device. Read the privacy policy in the app for the full detail.

Free to use. Ads support the app. GDPR: your choices are saved on your device.

Times shown in your local timezone — locale-aware, worldwide.
